instruction: Locate Counter-Strike 2 and add all available DLC items to the shopping cart.

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Counter-Strike 2 in Steam store and adding DLC items to cart. Uses existing is_added_to_steam_cart metric to verify cart content. Similar complexity to original Dota 2 task.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction requires adding 'all available DLC items' (plural, emphasis on ALL) but evaluator only checks for one specific item: 'Counter-Strike 2 Collector's Pack'
Cannot verify completeness: If Counter-Strike 2 has multiple DLC items, the evaluator would pass even if only one was added, not all of them
Critical coverage gap: The core requirement of the instruction (ALL DLC items) is not semantically verifiable with the current expected value
Uncertain DLC catalog: No way to determine if 'Collector's Pack' is the only DLC or if there are others that should also be checked
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Update expected items to include the complete list of all Counter-Strike 2 DLC items available on Steam (e.g., if there are multiple packs, list them all)
Alternatively, simplify the instruction to match the verification: 'Locate Counter-Strike 2 and add the Collector's Pack DLC to the shopping cart'
If only one DLC exists, add metadata documentation confirming 'Collector's Pack' is the sole DLC for Counter-Strike 2
Consider adding a count check or using a getter that can extract all cart items to verify completeness
